points.quote: `packages/frontend/` holds the client code ... `packages/backend/` holds `server` (`@affine/server`) and `native` ... `packages/common/` holds code shared by client and server
`tools/` holds the CLI, changelog, commitlint and utility tooling. ... `tests/` holds the end-to-end suites
`blocksuite/` is the editor engine, split into three layers

`web` is the browser app. `electron` and `electron-renderer` are the desktop app. `mobile` and `mobile-shared` are the mobile web UI. `ios` and `android` are the native mobile shells. `admin` is also built as its own app
`native` and `mobile-native` are native bindings. ... `native`, the Rust bindings for the server (`@affine/server-native`)
It is what makes cloud sync, collaboration and self-hosting possible. The client works without it.
It serves a GraphQL API at `/graphql` ... PostgreSQL, accessed through Prisma ... Redis, set through `REDIS_SERVER_HOST`.
